title: Compatible quotient models with actual reduction isomorphisms
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I=K+(a)$ with $K\subseteq A$ an ideal and $a\in A$, and $E$ a commutative $I$-adically complete $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Put $A_m=A/(a^m)$, $K_m=KA_m$, and $E_m=E/a^mE$ for $m\geq1$. Suppose each $E_m$ is $K_m$-adically complete and, for every $m$, there exists a finite type $A_m$-algebra $D_m$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], etale over $\operatorname{Spec}A_m\setminus V(K_m)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] [def-weil-etale-morphism], with an $A_m$-algebra isomorphism $\widehat{D_m}_{K_m}\cong E_m$. Then one can choose finite type $A_m$-algebras $C_m$, etale over that same complement, maps $v_m:C_m\to E_m$ inducing isomorphisms on $K_m$-adic completions, and $A$-algebra maps $t_m:C_m\to C_{m-1}$ for $m\geq2$, such that $t_m$ induces an isomorphism $C_m/a^{m-1}C_m\xrightarrow{\sim}C_{m-1}$ and $v_{m-1}t_m$ is the composite of $v_m$ with $E_m\to E_{m-1}$. The choice of $C_1\to E_1$ can be fixed in advance. No etaleness of $t_m$ is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof from “We claim that we may choose” through the application of lemma-lift-approximation, before “By construction”.

proof.text: Fix the prescribed valid model $C_1\to E_1$. Inductively suppose $C_1,\ldots,C_{m-1}$ and their maps have been chosen. Write $R=C_{m-1}$, $T=A_m$, $H=K_m$, $b=a^{m-1}\in T$, and $J=(b)\subseteq T$. Then $J^2=0$ since $2(m-1)\geq m$, and $T/J=A_{m-1}$. Choose an independent model $D=D_m\to E_m$ by the hypothesis, and put $D_0=D/bD$. All of $T,T/J,R,D,D_0$ are Noetherian: they are finite type algebras over $A$, so apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian].

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: Completion of $D_0$ along $H$ is canonically $E_{m-1}$. Indeed apply [lem-weil-pbc-completion-exact-finite-modules], over the Noetherian ring $D$ with ideal $HD$, to the two exact sequences $D\twoheadrightarrow bD$ and $0\to bD\to D\to D_0\to0$. Completion of the surjection onto $bD$ is surjective, and its composite into $\widehat D$ is multiplication by $b$ (coordinatewise in the defining inverse limits). Thus $\widehat {D_0}=\widehat D/b\widehat D=E_m/bE_m=E_{m-1}$, with the actual quotient maps. The base change $D_0$ is etale away from $V(K_{m-1})$ by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits].

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: Use the two specified completion identifications to form $\varphi:\widehat {D_0}\xrightarrow{\sim}E_{m-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat R$. Apply [lem-per-etale-away-completion-finite-refinement] over $A_{m-1}$ with ideal $K_{m-1}$. It gives $j:R\to R'$ etale finitely presented, $R/KR\cong R'/KR'$, and $u:D_0\to R'$ whose completion is $\widehat j\varphi$. By [lem-sfb-augmented-etale-associated-graded] applied to $j$ and the ideal $KR'$, the canonical maps $R/K^nR\to R'/K^nR'$ are isomorphisms for all $n$. Their inverse limit shows $\widehat j$ is an isomorphism, hence $\widehat u$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: The map $u:D_0\to R'$ is etale everywhere. Away from $V(K)$, both algebras are etale over $A_{m-1}$: for $R'$ use the etaleness of $R\to R'$ and [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. The same node implies etaleness of $u$ there. On every $K$-power quotient, $u$ induces an isomorphism by [lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete] and its completion isomorphism. Both $D_0,R'$ are Noetherian finite type $A_{m-1}$-algebras (for $R'$ use [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra-noetherian]), hence $R'$ is finite type over $D_0$ (its finitely many base-algebra generators still generate). Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-infinitesimal-neighbourhoods] to $\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}D_0$, with closed subscheme $V(KD_0)$, to obtain etaleness above $V(K)$ as well. The two loci cover the source.

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: Apply [lem-exc-etale-algebra-lift] to the etale finitely presented $D_0$-algebra $R'$ and the quotient $D\to D_0$. Obtain an etale finitely presented $D$-algebra $D'$ and a specified isomorphism $D'/bD'\cong R'$ reducing its structure map to $u$. Here $u$ is finitely presented by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-algebra-finite-presentation-localization]. Base change to the complement of $V(H)$ and apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]: $D'$ is etale over $T$ there. It is finite type over $T$, by adjoining the finite generators first of $D/T$ and then of $D'/D$.

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: Here is the omitted completion check in 0AKA. The etale map $D/HD\to D'/HD'$ is etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits]. Modulo the image of $(b)$ it is $D_0/KD_0\to R'/KR'$, an isomorphism from Step 3 and [lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete]. That image has square zero in both rings. Apply [lem-sfb-augmented-etale-associated-graded] with the target ideal $(b)$: its preimage is the source ideal $(b)$, and its $n=2$ assertion gives $D/HD\cong D'/HD'$. Apply the same node to $D\to D'$ and the ideal $HD'$ to get $D/H^nD\cong D'/H^nD'$ for every $n$. Taking the inverse limit defines $\widehat {D'}\cong\widehat D=E_m$. On reduction modulo $b$, this identification is the inverse of $\widehat j:\widehat R\to\widehat {R'}$, followed by the given $\widehat R\cong E_{m-1}$: Step 3 specified $\widehat u=\widehat j\varphi$, so the completed reduction square commutes with these exact maps.

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: Apply [lem-per-nilpotent-etale-neighbourhood-pushout-lift] with base ring $T$, ideal $H$, nilpotent ideal $J=(b)$, $C=D'$, $B_0=R$, and $h_0=j:R\to D'/bD'=R'$. The hypotheses hold: $D'$ is etale away from $V(H)$, $R$ is the previous model, and $j$ is etale and an isomorphism modulo $K$. Obtain $B\to D'$ etale, $\beta:B/bB\xrightarrow{\sim}R$ with reduction $j\beta$, and $B$ finite type over $T$, etale away from $V(H)$.

source.place: Tag 0AKA (lemma-approximate), proof of the compatible-model claim, with Tags 0AKJ and 0ALT; completion preservation expanded using 0H1D.

proof.text: The completion of $B\to D'$ is an isomorphism. To verify it, reduce that etale map modulo $H$ using [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits]. Modulo $(b)$ it becomes $R/KR\to R'/KR'$, an isomorphism. Since $b^2=0$, the $n=2$ assertion of [lem-sfb-augmented-etale-associated-graded] gives $B/HB\cong D'/HD'$. Applying the same node with ideal $HD'$ gives $B/H^nB\cong D'/H^nD'$ for every $n$. Inverse limits now give $\widehat B\cong\widehat {D'}\cong E_m$. Set $C_m=B$, let $v_m$ be $B\to D'\to\widehat {D'}\cong E_m$, and let $t_m$ be $B\twoheadrightarrow B/bB\xrightarrow{\beta}R$. Its quotient isomorphism is $\beta$. Its composite to $E_{m-1}$ equals $v_m$ reduced modulo $b$: the reduction of $B\to D'$ is $j\beta$, while the reduction of $D'\to E_m$ on $R'$ is the inverse-completion-of-$j$ map specified in Step 6. Their composite on $R$ is its original $v_{m-1}$. This extends the chosen finite tower without changing its earlier terms. Recursion, choosing an extension at each integer $m\geq2$, gives the required tower with the original $C_1\to E_1$.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q119-71cdf9441 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the source at restricted.tex 0AKA (the compatible-model claim, lines 2124-2166), 0AKJ (1846-1912) and 0ALT (1934-2043). The item statement is unchanged and matches the 0AKA claim, with K=(a_1..a_{t-1}) and a=a_t. There is no repair note, so this is a first split. The 8 steps are correct. Step 1: J^2=0 because 2(m-1)>=m. Step 2: by exactness of completion, D_0's completion is E_{m-1}. Step 3: the new 0AKJ node plus 0H1D make the completion of j an isomorphism. Step 4: u is étale off V(K) by cancellation and over V(K) by 0A43, since the K-power quotients are isomorphic. Step 5: the étale lift gives D'. Step 6: two 0H1D applications with b^2=0 write out the source's 'details omitted'; the completion isomorphism reduces mod b to v_{m-1}-hat composed with the inverse of j-hat, which I checked by naturality. Step 7: all three 0ALT hypotheses hold with T, H, (b), D', R and j. Step 8: v_{m-1}t_m equals v_m reduced to E_{m-1}, which I checked. The induction keeps the earlier models unchanged and starts from the fixed C_1. Both new nodes are true and are not restatements. For the 0AKJ refinement, the completion of u equals the completion of j composed with phi; I tested I=0, IR=R (where R'=0 is allowed) and I the unit ideal. The 0ALT lift matches the source hypothesis by hypothesis; I tested J=0 and I the unit ideal. Neither node duplicates an existing one: lem-per-etale-away-completion-hom-lifting is only the henselian-target case, and no other node carries 0ALT. Every bracketed citation in the steps is in uses and proof_deps, and every cited statement says what its step takes from it. I accept the declared tool uses of lem-exc-etale-algebra-lift, lem-sfb-augmented-etale-associated-graded (0H1D) and the 0A43 node as generic algebra. No fixes.

lean.note: Positive level m is indexed by n=m-1. The first model and map are preserved literally; the completion equivalences extend v, quotient equivalences induce t, and the transitions commute with A and with the actual quotient reductions of E. Auxiliary abbreviations and maps are explicit applications of Mathlib constructions, not new independent notions.
